justification: One image reference in the drawdown-verify CI job changes from the AWS ECR Public mirror, which returned toomanyrequests Data limit exceeded on 6 of 6 pulls on 2026-10-17 (main runs 38982626267 and 38984636569, PR run 38984330325 three attempts), to Google's mirror.gcr.io copy of the same official postgres:16 image.

break_it.scenario: mirror.gcr.io is also unreachable or rate limited from GitHub-hosted runners
break_it.what_happens: the drawdown-verify job fails at Initialize containers with a pull error, visibly red, never silently green
break_it.how: a failed service container pull fails the job; check_pr_gates.py refuses to merge on a failed run
break_it.repro: point image at a nonexistent tag and push

post_merge.manual_verify: the gates run on main after merge shows the drawdown-verify job green
